bibl.title: Polycrates' Guests: Extraneous Text and Ancient Conservation on P.Oxy. 1790.
bibl.seg: Enrico Emanuele Prodi, Polycrates' Guests: Extraneous Text and Ancient Conservation on P.Oxy. 1790.
bibl.note: Examines the conservation work which P. Oxy. XV, 1790 (= MP3 1237; LDAB 2434) underwent in antiquity. The combination of multispectral images (MSI) and careful inspection of the original in situ allows a more precise understanding of the work carried out by the conservator and of the materials he used. It is established that the extraneous text made visible by the MSI is written on the verso of the strips of papyrus that were used by the conservator. Includes a partial transcription of the text together with an attempt at interpretation.
